## Coding Standards

- Use functional Components for All React Code
- Prefer `const` over `let`
- Always include JSDoc comments for exported functions
- Prefer using `tailwind css` over defining custom css classes

## Linting and formatting

- Linting and Formatting verification should be done by invoking `npm run format:check` and `npm run lint:check`
- Linting and Formatting should be fixed by invoking `npm run format` and `npm run lint`

## Commit message convention

- This repo uses `commitlint` tool. Please verify the commit message conventions in ../commitlint.config.js file
